segments.name: Community banking
segments.description: Provides a variety of community banking services to individual and corporate customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which provides a variety of community banking services to individual and corporate customers.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans, and customers pay fees and service charges on depository products and other banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: The segment's revenues are driven primarily by interest income on loans, interest and dividend on debt securities, interest-bearing deposits with banks, cash and due from banks, and fees and service charges on depository products and other banking services.
